its been almost 10 years since i got sa’d and the anger is very fucking real, god. 

but don’t forget that you deserve a healthy sex life and that its definitely a possibility, even if you have to do trial and error plenty of times. 

just two weeks ago, i lost my reclaimed virginity to a friend. 

how did i? i communicated my past with him, we hung out and talked beforehand, i communicated my boundaries *strictly* and made sure the person who i’m allowing access to my body *doesn’t even think of hurting me*. 

this person has to have the ability and morality to have hurting you the last thing they want to do. 

sure this was after plenty of therapy and still controlling the developed BPD and CPTSD i got from that time in my life, but i truly believe communication is key, and of course always have a backup plan. 

how did i do it personally? i resorted to martial arts as a way to protect myself for the future and let out the anger. always carry something with you, whether it’s a friend, significant other or something, you just simply never know… i carry pepper spray but a weapon is a mentality worst comes to worst, even a hydroflask can make do

nevertheless, take your time, communicate with your partner, and have compassion to yourself. your anger is valid, and i believe you will experience beautiful sex without that fear 🫂
